en.text:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness.

Grants Peregrine Strike after sprinting for 2 seconds and being airborne for 0.5 seconds. Buff is removed upon touching the ground.

Peregrine Strike increases the impact damage of Shoulder Charge Melee Abilities by 250%.

Against <link Minibosses [#CombatantClassifications] />, the buff is increased to 550% and refunds your Melee Ability charge on hit.

Shoulder Charge abilities: <arc/>Seismic Strike, <solar/>Hammer Strike, and <void/>Shield Bash

Provides no benefits when hitting <stasis/>Frozen enemies.
